# Gali

Gali is the campus marketplace with escrow. It lets university students buy and sell safely within their school: payments are held in escrow and only released after the buyer and seller meet, inspect the item, and confirm in person at a campus handoff spot.

## Pages
- https://gali.com.ng/ - Home: live listings, campus stats, escrow explainer, demo videos.
- https://gali.com.ng/how-it-works - How the buy, escrow, and handoff flow works.
- https://gali.com.ng/sell - For sellers: free listings, verified storefront, escrow payouts.
- https://gali.com.ng/faq - Frequently asked questions about escrow, safety, campuses, and fees.
- https://gali.com.ng/signup - Create a buyer or seller account.

## Key facts
- Campus-verified accounts.
- Escrow custody: money is locked until in-person confirmation.
- Cheap and accessible: free standard listings, optional Pro plan.
- Live across several Nigerian universities, expanding.
- App: https://app.gali.com.ng
